title: RDPEAR: Change some IDL not supported by pidl
description:
typdef support in pidl does not support the structures used here, so
workaround that by defining them in other ways.

See:
https://bugzilla.samba.org/show_bug.cgi?id=3707
https://bugzilla.samba.org/show_bug.cgi?id=7388

Before:

        Use of uninitialized value $idl in split at wireshark/tools/pidl/lib/Parse/Pidl/Wireshark/NDR.pm line 144.
        Use of uninitialized value $idl in split at wireshark/tools/pidl/lib/Parse/Pidl/Wireshark/NDR.pm line 144.
        Use of uninitialized value in numeric gt (>) at wireshark/tools/pidl/lib/Parse/Pidl/Wireshark/NDR.pm line 770.

notes.body: I know @hardening1 added this dissector, but I haven't been able to find any sample files on the original MR to check any changes.
added this merge request to the [merge train](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_trains) at position 2
